hellofresh.provider_link_label: Need to reach HelloFresh? Customer service options
hellofresh.meta_description: Official HelloFresh contact-us page and Terms: phone, web chat, and Help Center paths.

fastest_path.text: HelloFresh’s contact-us page offers web chat (“Have a question?”) and lists a phone line to call the team.

items.text: Call our team 1 (646) 846-3663 (published on HelloFresh’s contact-us page).
Use the web chat on hellofresh.com/contact-us (HelloFresh loads chat on that contact page).
Browse HelloFresh’s Help Center & FAQ at hellofresh.com/about/faq.
For account questions, HelloFresh Terms also reference reaching Customer Care via hellofresh.com/contact-us (see Section 10.3 cancellation / Customer Care wording).

factor.provider_link_label: Need to reach Factor? Customer service options
factor.meta_description: Official Factor contact page phone and chat, plus Terms Customer Care paths.

fastest_path.text: Factor’s contact page lists web chat and a phone number to call the team.

items.text: Call our team +1 888-573-5727 (published on factor75.com/contact).
Factor Terms also list 1-(888) 573-5727 for account security notifications (Section 4.3).
Use web chat on factor75.com/contact (Factor loads chat on the contact page).
Factor publishes Help & FAQ at factor75.com/faq.
Factor Terms reference contacting Customer Care via factor75.com/contact for subscription termination (Section 5.2). Use that official contact page rather than third-party lists.

homechef.provider_link_label: Need to reach Home Chef? Customer service options
homechef.meta_description: Home Chef Help Center article on phone hours and the support request form.

fastest_path.text: Home Chef says the best way to reach them is by sending a message through their Help Center request form.

items.text: Send a message via support.homechef.com/hc/en-us/requests/new (linked from Home Chef’s “Who can I contact…” article).
Home Chef Help Center home: support.homechef.com/hc/en-us.

hours.text: Phone hours published by Home Chef: 9 AM to 6 PM CT Monday–Friday and Saturday 10 AM to 2 PM CT; phone lines not open Sunday (send a message instead).

blueapron.provider_link_label: Need to reach Blue Apron? Customer service options
blueapron.meta_description: Blue Apron Terms list Customer Support contact paths and a published phone number.

fastest_path.text: Blue Apron Terms tell customers to contact Customer Support (linked from the Terms) for subscription and order issues.

items.text: Phone: 888-278-4349 (published in Blue Apron Terms contact block).
Blue Apron Terms reference contacting Customer Support for cancellations, credits, and product issues (see Cancellation Policy and related sections).
Blue Apron publishes Help Center & FAQ from its site footer (support.blueapron.com/hc/en-us).
Blue Apron Terms reference email contact for product and billing topics; use the Customer Support paths linked from blueapron.com/pages/terms rather than copying addresses from mirrors.

hungryroot.provider_link_label: Need to reach Hungryroot? Customer service options
hungryroot.meta_description: Hungryroot Help Center: chatbot, text line, and published human support hours.

fastest_path.text: Hungryroot’s Help Center says the fastest service is to start with their chatbot using the icon in the bottom-right corner.

items.text: Start with the chatbot anytime using the icon in the bottom-right corner on Hungryroot’s Help Center pages.
Text a human directly at 855-222-5704 (published on Hungryroot’s contact article).
Hungryroot Help Center: support.hungryroot.com/hc/en-us.

hours.text: Human support hours published by Hungryroot: 10am–6pm ET every day except July 4th, Thanksgiving Day, Christmas Day, and New Year’s Day.

everyplate.provider_link_label: Need to reach EveryPlate? Customer service options
everyplate.meta_description: EveryPlate contact page phone and chat, plus Terms Customer Care phone.

fastest_path.text: EveryPlate’s contact page offers web chat and a published phone number.

items.text: Call our team +1 (973) 210-4915 (everyplate.com/contact).
EveryPlate Terms also list EveryPlate Customer Care at (973) 210-4915 for subscription cancellation by phone (Section 10.3).
Use web chat on everyplate.com/contact.
EveryPlate FAQ: everyplate.com/about/faq.
EveryPlate Terms reference EveryPlate Customer Care at everyplate.com/contact for written cancellation requests (Section 10.3).

greenchef.provider_link_label: Need to reach Green Chef? Customer service options
greenchef.meta_description: Green Chef Terms and contact paths: phone, chat, and Customer Care contact page.

fastest_path.text: Green Chef Terms reference customer care at greenchef.com/contact and web chat on Green Chef contact pages.

items.text: Green Chef Terms list 888-236-7295 for account security notifications (Section 4.3).
Green Chef Terms reference customer care at greenchef.com/contact (including text-message support options).
Green Chef publishes Help center and FAQ links in its site footer (see Terms page footer).
Green Chef Terms say you may contact customer care at greenchef.com/contact for text-message and account support (Communications section).

cookunity.provider_link_label: Need to reach CookUnity? Customer service options
cookunity.meta_description: CookUnity Help Center, support request form, and Terms contact email.

fastest_path.text: CookUnity’s Terms and Help Center direct customers to support.cookunity.com and the Help Center request form.

items.text: CookUnity Help Center: support.cookunity.com/hc/en-us (includes in-page virtual assistant chat on articles).
Submit a request at support.cookunity.com/hc/en-us/requests/new (CookUnity Zendesk sign-in may be required).
items.source_label: CookUnity Help Center — Submit a request

items.text: CookUnity Terms footer directs customers to contact CookUnity via the channels on cookunity.com/terms (use the Help Center request form or in-page contact paths rather than copying an address from mirrors).
No dedicated customer-service phone number found on CookUnity’s official Terms or Help Center pages we fetched — use Help Center chat or the support request form.
items.source_label: CookUnity Help Center (no phone listed on pages we checked)
